description.narrative:
The Pacific Innovation Hub will better connect the New Zealand private sector with Pacific entrepreneurs and businesses to support Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) outcomes in the Pacific, through delivery of;
  • an engagement platform bringing together private sector stakeholders to consider and overcome challenges.
  • a viability gap fund for exploring the validity of commercial opportunities with development outcomes.
  • an ‘ideas lab’ to trial and test new ideas for private sector engagement.
